package_info.why_malicious: This report is a high-level threat intelligence summary and does not provide specific package-level information or code samples. It references several malware families (Ryuk, Sodinokibi, Egregor, Emotet, SUNBURST, TearDrop) and vulnerabilities, but does not describe any particular software package or include code snippets.

behavioral_signatures: Ransomware encrypting files and demanding payment
Abuse of legitimate tools for malicious purposes (e.g., BitLocker for ransomware)
file_indicators: Presence of ransomware note files (e.g., RyukReadMe.txt, Sodinokibi ransom notes)
Unusual executable files dropped in system directories
Suspicious DLLs associated with SUNBURST or TearDrop
network_indicators: Outbound connections to known C2 infrastructure for Ryuk, Sodinokibi, Egregor, Emotet
Connections to suspicious or newly registered domains
Unusual traffic to cryptocurrency wallets or exchange portals
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for ransomware-specific file creation and encryption activity, detect known malware signatures and behaviors (Ryuk, Sodinokibi, Egregor, Emotet, SUNBURST, TearDrop), watch for suspicious outbound network connections, and alert on exploitation of known vulnerabilities (e.g., MVPower DVR, Nvidia GPU, FortiWeb, Android RCE).
